Global (All).title: Russia-Ukraine Conflict
Global (All).summary: Heavy fighting in eastern Ukraine and a significant escalation of military build-up in eastern Europe

Global (All).title: Global Economic Recession
Global (All).summary: Concerns of a global recession due to rising inflation, monetary policy tightening and supply chain disruptions

Global (All).title: Rise of Global Tensions
Global (All).summary: Increased tensions between the US, China and other world powers over trade, security and technology

United States.title: Tensions between the US and Iran escalate after a drone strike
United States.summary: Iran's IRGC warns of retaliation after US drone strike kills top Iranian military commander in Baghdad airport, escalating tensions between the two nations.

United States.title: California wildfires prompt state of emergency declaration
United States.summary: Governor declares state of emergency as several wildfires burn in California, forcing evacuations and threatening critical infrastructure.

United States.title: Supreme Court upholds Trump-era immigration rule, drawing criticism from advocacy groups
United States.summary: Supreme Court rules that US can deny green cards to immigrants who use or have used public benefits, sparking criticism from immigration advocates and Democrats.

South Korea and the US have agreed to conduct joint military drills in May as part of their annual Foal Eagle exercise, sparking fears among North Korea.

Japan.title: Typhoon Nanmadol Weakens as It Moves Over Southern Japan
Japan.summary: Typhoon Nanmadol made landfall in southern Japan on September 16, causing widespread power outages and damage. The storm brought strong winds and heavy rainfall, with some areas seeing up to 30 inches of rain.

Japan.title: Ruling Party Loses Control of Okayama Prefecture in Election
Japan.summary: The ruling Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) lost control of Okayama Prefecture in a recent election, marking a significant setback for the party.

Japan.title: Tokyo University Students Stage Protest Over Education Reforms
Japan.summary: Students at Tokyo University staged a protest over education reforms, citing concerns about the impact on their education and future careers.
